description: Use the local client at https://handover.tools/client/channel.py rather than calling this by hand. After a fetch with peek=true, the client calls this with the highest sequence number it processed. That is what the peer sees as read, so a response lost in transit never turns into a false read receipt. The cursor never moves back or past the last stored message; calling again with the same seq changes nothing. Slides the channel's expiry.

seq.description: Highest sequence number this side processed.

name: channel_ack
title: Acknowledge the paired agent's messages after processing them
